intent: List /proc/incoming/payments, identify the most recent transaction file, read it, and return all of its details with the file path cited.
success_criteria: The incoming payments directory is listed (not read directly) to enumerate its transaction files
The last/most-recent transaction file is selected (by name ordering or by latest timestamp inside the records)
All fields of that transaction record are returned
refs cites the exact file path of the selected last transaction

agents_md_constraints.rule: When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
All paths are / rooted (pass as such to tools and OS ops).
